cards.answer: Annie is a mage who deals magic damage with spells and can stun enemies. She can shield an ally and summon Tibbers to fight alongside her. Focus on AP to learn how her spells scale.
cards.counterplay: Watch her stun counter and spread out to reduce the impact of her area spells.

cards.answer: Annie builds up to four stacks, empowering an offensive spell to consume them and stun enemies hit. Her stun is ready at the start of the game and after she respawns.
cards.counterplay: Watch the counter under Annie's health bar and respect her stun when it lights up.

cards.answer: Annie fires a targeted fireball that deals magic damage. If it kills the target, its mana cost is refunded and its cooldown is reduced.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance when Annie's stun is ready to avoid giving her an easy target.

cards.answer: Annie releases a cone of fire in a chosen direction, dealing magic damage to enemies hit.
cards.counterplay: Avoid clustering in front of Annie so her cone is less likely to hit multiple allies.

cards.priority_reason: The cone can damage and potentially stun several enemies.
uncertainties: A target behind Annie can be hit if its radius intersects the cone.

cards.answer: Annie shields herself or an allied champion and grants a burst of movement speed; Tibbers also receives these effects. While a shield is active, eligible enemies that damage it with attacks or spells take magic damage.
cards.counterplay: Consider the shield and its retaliation before attacking a protected target.

cards.priority_reason: The shield and speed can protect an ally, while retaliation discourages attacks.
uncertainties: Retaliation is limited to once per enemy per cast for each active shield; specific exceptions and reported bugs exist.

cards.answer: Annie summons Tibbers at a chosen location, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. Tibbers stays to attack and burn nearby enemies, and Annie can recast the ability to direct him.
cards.counterplay: Spread out against the initial summon and move away from Tibbers to avoid his attacks and nearby burn.
